description: Shared facial expression library (face_generic/1). Two layers: ACTION UNITS are single facial motions that every face generates from its own geometry and landmarks (shape keys of these names, plus the DEF-jaw bone for JawOpen). PRESETS are semantic expressions defined only as weights of action units; they are baked per character into shape keys of the preset name (and jaw drivers), so Blender controls and engine morphs use the same names. Characters tune intensities and override weights in spec.face.expressions; nothing here is character-specific.

action_units.Blink.L: upper lid of the character's left eye closes onto the lower lid (lid seam; lash follows; optional eyeball flatten)
action_units.Blink.R: the same for the right eye
action_units.EyeWide: upper lids rise, lower lids drop (both eyes)
action_units.EyeSquint: lower lids rise, upper lids lower slightly (both eyes)
action_units.BrowDown: inner brow ends drop and move inwards (both)
action_units.BrowSad: inner brow ends rise, outer ends drop (both)
action_units.MouthSmile: closed-lip smile: corners up and out; cheeks rise; lower lids rise (smile coupling)
action_units.MouthWide: open smile: upper lip lifts, lower lip drops into a U, corners up; shows the oral layers (teeth, tongue)
action_units.MouthO: small round opening (lips narrow and part)
action_units.JawOpen: jaw bone rotation plus the lips' JawOpen shape

presets_source: Blendshape matrix of reference #34 (girl_auburn_bun_glasses): Neutral, Blink, Left Eye Closed, Right Eye Closed, Squint, Wide-Open, Smile, Frown, Surprise, Sadness, Anger, Confusion, Laugh, Mouth Open (the matrix repeats Frown and Surprise). Weights are my reading of the tiles, not measured.
optional_presets_note: Not in any reference; named in the M3 request. Built only when a character lists them in spec.face.expressions.optional. SmileClosed and Thinking (T-031): closed-mouth smile and a thinking face (one brow up, small pursed mouth) for expression sheets; opt-in per spec. SmileOpen and Pout (T-109): the open D-shaped smile with lifted cheeks (girl ref_30) and the closed sulky pout (boy hero24 / #08) as named presets the emotion library can drive; units a face does not build (CheekRaise, MouthPout) are skipped.
